Snapmaker Orca 2.4.2  Release Notes
---
New Features
1. Added a Print History entry on the home page to quickly view past print tasks.
[image]
2. Upgraded the original Model Library entry to Online Models, allowing users to browse and jump to the Snapmaker Space website directly from the home page.
[image]
3. Added a multi-dovetail cutting option alongside the existing single-dovetail cutting to support larger joint sizes.
[image]
4. Added Subdivision mesh to improve surface continuity, making model details smoother and enhancing the surface quality of printed parts.
[image]
5. Added model shadow display to make previews more realistic and three-dimensional. It can be enabled or disabled in Preferences (currently available on Windows and Linux only).
[image]
Improvements
1. Added a "Don't ask again next time" checkbox to the bottom-left of the Memory Usage Warning. The prompt can be restored at any time in Preferences.
[image]
2. Optimized the top-surface path generation algorithm to improve top infill path quality and surface flatness, enhancing the appearance of printed parts.
[image]
3. Optimized print speed control for overhang areas to improve overhang quality and reduce stringing and sagging.
[image]
4. Significantly improved UI responsiveness and reduced latency during painting.
5. Optimized click-selection responsiveness in large scenes and increased the pick success rate for hollow models, making objects easier to select.
Preset Configuration Updates
1. Added filament preset Snapmaker PLA Starlight@U1 for 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 mm nozzles.
2. Added filament preset Snapmaker PLA Gradient@U1 for 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 mm nozzles.
3. Added filament preset Snapmaker PLA Marble@U1 for 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 mm nozzles.
4. Added filament preset Snapmaker Nylon@U1 and J1 for 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 mm nozzles.
5. Added filament preset Snapmaker PETG@U1 and J1 for 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 mm nozzles.
6. Added filament preset Generic PVA@U1 for 0.6 and 0.8 mm nozzles.
7. Added filament preset Generic PA@U1 for 0.6 and 0.8 mm nozzles.
8. Added filament preset Generic PA-CF@U1 for 0.6 and 0.8 mm nozzles.
9. Removed High Flow Hotend parameters for PEBA 90A and TPU filaments.
10. Adjusted the filaments incompatible with High Flow to: TPU and PEBA 90A.
11. Added more preset filament colors.
Bug Fixes
1. Fixed the issue where, after enabling the Raft and setting the Support interface fan speed to 50%, this setting was incorrectly applied to the inner and outer walls of the model's first layer.
2. Fixed the issue where, at the end of printing, the nozzle traveled from the model to the wipe tower without lifting, which could cause the tip forming line to be printed incorrectly.
3. Fixed the issue where the retraction before wiping did not match the setting.
4. Fixed the issue where the G-code preview after slicing the same model was inconsistent with the exported G-code when reopened.
5. Fixed the issue where filament was incorrectly assigned for internal bridging in special cases.
6. Fixed the issue where no space was left for the prime tower when the model covered the entire plate.
7. Fixed the issue where the total layers count in the G-code comment line was inconsistent with the layer height shown in the slicing preview.
8. Fixed an issue where, under the same mixed-color scheme, slicing paths for painted areas that covered previously painted areas were not merged into a single toolpath.
9. Fixed an issue where, when Subdivide Mix Layer was enabled, the sub-layer height did not match the percentage-based blend ratio (non-1:1).
10. Fixed the issue where colors were sorted in no particular order when blending three colors into multi-color sub-layers.
11. Fixed the issue where colors were printed incorrectly due to missing toolhead change commands when Subdivide Mix Layer and Prime Tower were enabled.
12. Fixed the issue where part of the model's colors was missing after configuring Color Mixing Match.
13. Fixed the issue where some filaments' mixing ratios were below the Min Mix Ratio in Match mode.
14. Fixed the issue where, after syncing a single filament, the original filament type was still used during slicing and upload/print.
15. Fixed the issue where High Flow could not be applied after modifying the process object configuration.
16. Fixed an issue where the high-flow parameters in the Retraction Length (Toolchange) could not be applied in some scenarios.
17. Fixed the issue where, when setting the brim in a 3MF file containing multiple objects, all brim filament used the filament of the first printed object.
18. Fixed the issue where Default Filament appeared after importing a 3MF file.
19. Fixed the issue where the filament color was displayed incorrectly in the UI after importing a 3MF file.
20. Fixed the issue where the color matching panel and the viewport showed inconsistent colors when importing an OBJ file with color data.
21. Fixed the issue where the software showed an error pop-up when importing an STL file larger than 2 GB.
22. Fixed the issue where the assembly view could not be displayed when the model file was too large.
23. Fixed the issue where other objects could not be selected after combining objects.
24. Fixed the issue where importing certain 3MF files for slicing caused the software to crash.
25. Fixed the issue where AppImage failed to open in some Linux environments due to system language compatibility issues.
26. Fixed the issue where an unsaved process blocked the shutdown or sign-out prompt on Windows.
27. Fixed the issue where the software could randomly crash when quitting on macOS.
28. Fixed the issue where the software crashed on the Pretreat the upload content and Print Preprocessing pages on macOS.
29. Fixed the issue where the version update pop-up displayed a white screen on macOS.
30. Fixed the issue where the application crashed during exit when automatic backup was enabled.
31. Fixed an issue where, during slicing, connecting to a device or switching back to the Preview page caused the slicing progress pop-up to disappear, and canceling the slicing became very slow.
32. Fixed the issue where opening a 3MF file with Snapmaker Orca by double-clicking failed when option "Allow only one Snapmaker Orca instance" was enabled and the software was already running.
33. Fixed the issue where launching Snapmaker Orca from the Mac Space site differed from Windows.
34. Updated the signing policy for the Windows installer package to prevent false positives from antivirus software.
35. Fixed the issue where, when using the Snapmaker Orca CLI slicing command, passing a 3MF project file path as a parameter caused slicing to be rejected due to a version mismatch. (Thanks to community user @KuzuriAo, PR #839.)
36. Fixed the issue where resource copying failed on Windows due to non-ASCII characters (e.g., Chinese) in the path.
37. Fixed the issue where the UI showed Generic ABS filament while the actual filament was Generic PLA.
38. Fixed the issue where the high/low-temperature filament mixing detection did not take effect after copying a model with Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V.
39. Fixed the issue where a blank prompt pop-up appeared when fewer than 4 filaments were defined in the 3MF file.
40. Fixed the issue where the plate could not be switched after opening a gcode.3MF file containing multiple plates.
41. Changed the default Nozzle type in Printer settings: the default type for the 0.4 mm nozzle was changed from Hardened steel to Stainless steel, and the default type for the 0.6 mm nozzle was changed from Stainless steel to Hardened steel. (Thanks to community user @kuzuriao)
